answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism: make identity cost a resource minted outside the network. A joining agent escrows tokens plus a hardware-bound proof before it earns. New identities start on a thin slice, like a glacier calving one slab; verified work widens it in umber-dark ledger steps, while fabricated accounts only pile shale: collateral locked for weeks, spendable never. Ten thousand puppets means ten thousand real deposits, each farmed account dragging its own slashed bond. Cheap identities are sybil fuel; priced, slashable ones are customers.
